dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Why, hello there. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: If this is about work, please allow me to decline for now. This festive season is quite hard to come by after all. Feeling the sea breeze, watching the Xiao Lanterns... It is all ever so pleasant...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Welcome! How may I assist you today?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: I am the account manager here at the Northland Bank. Feel free to find me for help with any matters you'd like to take care of in the bank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: If you're interested in a loan, I can assure you that our interest rates are better than any of the local lenders you'll find around Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: You'll also find our savings accounts much more competitive as well. Our interest return on savings will surely be higher than any local lender!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: So no matter what your business may be, Northland Bank can always be the first to meet your banking needs!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: This is actually a Snezhnayan bank that was opened here in Liyue Harbor. The building itself was constructed in accordance with the local Liyue style.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: However, many Liyue locals still seem to harbor some resentment towards our bank. They think that our presence here may be damaging the Liyue economy.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: But this clearly can be an opportunity that benefits everyone. As long as we can be fully integrated into the marketplace, the economy will only continue to grow more.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: As for our own nation's economy, we have the brilliance and foresight of Master Pantalone to thank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Oh, and we mustn't forget Her Majesty the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: We look forward to your next visit with us. Please find me for any business matters that require assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Welcome! How may I assist you to...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Oh wait, I'm already off the clock now. What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've been enjoying all that Liyue Harbor has to offer?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: As a native of Snezhnaya, I was initially quite reluctant about being transferred to Liyue by the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: But as I came to understand more about Liyue, I found myself liking it more and more.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Things like the sea here and the city's atmosphere are all quite different from my home, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Tell me about your home.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: My hometown is not quite as lively as the bustling city of Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: And I've completely fallen in love with the food in Liyue. With such a variety of colors, flavors, and aromas, the cuisine here is simply exquisite!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: But even so, I could never turn my back on Her Majesty the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Ah, seeing as I still have to work tomorrow, I'll need to take the chance now to relax.
